_doc: Peripheral capabilities, reserved pins and reset state of the two MCUs. Only pins checked against a source are listed: a contract signal on any other pin fails until its row is added from the source.

sources.signals: ST STM32_open_pin_data mcu/STM32G431R(6-8-B)Tx.xml, checked 2026-10-01; PA6 from DS12589 table 13 (LQFP64 pin 20: ADC2_IN3, OPAMP2_VOUT), checked 2026-10-06; PB14 (pin 36: ADC1_IN5) from the same XML, checked 2026-10-07
sources.af: Zephyr hal_stm32 dts/st/g4/stm32g431r(6-8-b)tx-pinctrl.dtsi and ST GPIO-STM32G43x_gpio_v1_0_Modes.xml, checked 2026-10-01
sources.reset: RM0440: GPIOs reset to analog mode except the debug pins (PA13 pull-up, PA14 pull-down, PA15 pull-up, PB4 pull-up, PB3 floating)

notes.PC14: Dominio de respaldo (pin RTC/LSE): salida de 2 MHz y 3 mA como máximo, una sola a la vez con PC13/PC15.
notes.PC15: Dominio de respaldo (pin RTC/LSE): salida de 2 MHz y 3 mA como máximo.
notes.PB4: Tras el reset es NJTRST con pull-up interno y además UCPD1_CC2: el BSP debe liberar JTAG y llamar a HAL_PWREx_DisableUCPDDeadBattery() antes de usarlo.
notes.PB6: UCPD1_CC1: el BSP debe llamar a HAL_PWREx_DisableUCPDDeadBattery() antes de fiarse del nivel leído.

sources.matrix: ESP32-S3 TRM, IO MUX and GPIO matrix: SPI, I2C, UART and LEDC route to any GPIO
sources.reserved: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 datasheet: GPIO26-32 drive the SPI flash/PSRAM, GPIO33-37 the octal PSRAM of N8R8; strapping pins 0, 3, 45, 46
sources.reset: Only GPIO0 is modelled with its reset pull-up; other pins are taken as high impedance
